notes: R30 compliance: mock-first - zero live agents, zero ports, zero DSH_HOME, zero DSH instances; the three public seams (AgentPresetSeam, TeamBlueprintPersonaSource, ScopedPersonaPromptSurface) are narrow injected interfaces mock-implemented in p5t2-helpers.ts; the real DSH public seam binding belongs to T5/T6. The real P3-T5 pure compatibility engine (packages/domain/compatibility, read-only import) is the classification dependency - the adapter states the canonical persona-composition requirement (type 'persona', complete:true) and the public fact (composable vs complete), and the engine classifies (PASS/SATISFIED vs BLOCKED_FATAL + TEAM_PERSONA_COMPLETE_PRESET_CONFLICT); a counting wrapper is test-only. The persona slot's FATAL throws BEFORE the binder's admission decision (T1 slot contract), so a complete-preset conflict can never reach work; the binder's frozen 5-code vocabulary stays untouched (binder/** read-only). Upstream assembly semantics are preserved by construction: the closed seams expose no mutation, the scoped identity is a deep-frozen closed lossless-JSON value installed as a scoped prompt section (Architecture 40.4), never a modification of the preset. No forbidden workaround (13.6): no force-complete-to-false, no Blueprint-persona ignoring, no dsh-persona private semantics, no upstream patch, no post-first-prompt patch-in. Every new module is transitively imported by a committed test. Toolchain: node 24.20.0 plain-node test runner (scripts/run-tests.mjs only; no pnpm run/exec, no vitest CLI / tsx / esbuild / vite, no piped-stdio child spawns), typescript 6.0.3 (tsc per package, erasable-only TS, NodeNext + verbatimModuleSyntax, noUncheckedIndexedAccess), pnpm 11.7.0 (install --ignore-scripts only); zero new dependencies; pnpm-lock.yaml untouched; no node: builtin imports in new .ts; no `node:` imports, relative imports with .js suffix, import type for type-only imports
